abilities.name: jab/get-menus
abilities.label: Get Nav Menus
abilities.description: Returns every registered WordPress nav menu with its items as a flat list and the theme locations each menu is assigned to. Items carry parent_id so consumers can rebuild the tree client-side.

locations.description: Theme-registered menu locations (e.g. "primary", "footer") this menu is assigned to.

items.description: Flat list of menu items. Use parent_id to reconstruct the tree.

target.description: Link target. Empty string for same-window, "_blank" for new window.

object_id.description: ID of the linked WP object, when applicable. 0 for custom URLs.

parent_id.description: ID of the parent menu item. 0 for top-level items.
